details: Essence is the main pool: built by the three Primary skills and some runes and passives, spent by Secondary skills, Command Skeletons and the Curses. Blood Rush and Simulacrum cost a percentage of Life, and twelve runes add or change a Life cost

details: Corpse Explosion explodes up to 5 corpses within 11 yards of the target area; Corpse Lance fires from corpses near the target (35 yards) or the caster (75); Devour consumes corpses within 60 yards (10 Essence each); Revive revives up to 10 corpses within 20 yards (minions last 15 seconds, at most 10 alive); Command Golem's active collapses the Golem into a pile of 5 corpses (8 with Flesh Golem); Bone Spirit's recharge drops 1 second per corpse consumed; Land of the Dead makes every corpse skill usable without a corpse (Devour's power spawns 10 corpses during it); Fueled by Death, Life from Death and the Devour and Bone Spirit runes read corpse consumption
notes: This is the part the other classes have no precedent for: a counted world object that skills read and spend. The skills carry no corpse cost on their Cost line, so the corpse is a requirement, not a pool.
